dialogues.speaker: Gafoor
dialogues.text: We need more manpower. How are we supposed to manage with so few people? You know what? Just do as much as you can.

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: So you guys met Lisa in Mondstadt? Are you sure she's just a plain old librarian?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yes, what's so strange about that?

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: I didn't think there was anything about that backwater that would attract her there. Such a waste of talent.

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: ... Okay, I know you're Lisa's friend, and I'm not gonna talk to her about that again, so stop giving me that dirty look.

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: I was kind enough to offer her a chance, but she didn't seem keen. Fine by me, I guess.

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: Yes, we carry out regular monitoring of the workings of Ley Lines. This is one of our fundamental research principles.

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: There are not enough talented folk who are professional and can independently undertake the work of exploring the Ley Lines. I've long said that we should allocate more people to come here...

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: Alas, I can't find any researchers, so I have to recruit willing volunteers.

response.speaker: Gafoor
response.text: It's up to you to explore and clean up this Domain.
